title: Change the details on a conveyancer licence – corporation
summary: Update the details on a conveyancer licence for a corporation if your business information has changed.
intro:
If your company holds a conveyancer licence and your details have changed, for example, your business name, address, appointed directors or partnership arrangements, you can update these details at a Service NSW Centre or by email.

You must notify NSW Fair Trading of any changes within 7 days.
who_can_apply: Your company holds a conveyancer licence and your details have changed (e.g., business name, address, appointed directors, or partnership arrangements).

how_to_steps.text: Download and complete the form Change of Details– Licensed Conveyancer – PDF (if applicable).

Visit a service centre and submit the information in person, or email propertylicensing@customerservice.nsw.gov.au.

faqs.q: How quickly must I notify NSW Fair Trading of changes?
faqs.a: You must notify NSW Fair Trading of any changes within 7 days.

faqs.q: What details can I update on my conveyancer licence?
faqs.a: You can update details such as your business name, address, appointed directors, or partnership arrangements.

faqs.q: How can I submit my updated details?
faqs.a: You can update your details at a Service NSW Centre or by emailing propertylicensing@customerservice.nsw.gov.au.
